svg.desc: G-ONE: does self-preservation evolve without being rewarded; crossroads-rl: multi-agent RL at unsignaled intersections; Afwah: misinformation cascade, Monte Carlo, 4 platforms; stride: GA bipedal locomotion + Three.js dashboard; Arivu: citation-ancestry research platform; adr-system: versioned research decision records on GitHub; APIN: leaf-disease diagnosis from a phone photo; ink-education: gamified pixel-art study toolkit; Sanchari: vehicle rental, Django REST + React/Vite; Yaatra: seasonal travel discovery and booking; leetcoder: Selenium + Claude API daily solver; cam-to-ascii: camera feed to ASCII
